concept.hr: Svaki sloj dodaje svoje zaglavlje na putu dolje i skida ga na putu gore
concept.en: Each layer adds its header going down and strips it coming up

summary.hr: Poruka silazi kroz stog pošiljatelja i penje se kroz stog primatelja: podaci, segment ili datagram, paket, okvir, sa svakom veličinom u oktetima.
summary.en: A message goes down the sender's stack and up the receiver's: data, segment or datagram, packet, frame, each with its size in octets.
